page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 40 virtual CPUs, which correspond to 20 physical cores with 2 threads per core, and 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.8 GB of memory per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average range for its hardware class. It achieves a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 2133.36 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server handles 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. For language model workloads, it processes 1841.39 prompt tokens per second on a small 135M model, dropping to 56.94 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

From a resource density perspective, the lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage attachment, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the storage volume configuration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high clock speeds and balanced memory allocation without the overhead of dedicated graphics hardware. It is suitable for general-purpose applications, database operations, web serving, and moderate CPU-based machine learning inference.
